summary: kafka-roller sdist exfiltrates host identifiers on install to third-party collectors
details: setup.py spawns a daemon thread at module-import time that collects hostname, current working directory, platform/uname output, a timestamp and a generated uuid, then POSTs the JSON payload to https://webhook.site/bf5cb178-e0cf-43b6-8b1e-fb5d2f6ea9c9 and performs HTTPS and DNS requests against the OAST host jw1yrpkm5xpav.httpcollaborator.com. The beacon fires on `pip install` from sdist and during PEP 517 wheel build, before any user code imports the package. The package name squats an internal name referenced by a public Tesla repository (teslamotors/kafka-helmsman) and the version is set implausibly high (99.0.5), a dependency-confusion shape intended to win resolution against an internal `kafka_roller` package. The package metadata self-labels as a Bugcrowd research artifact, but the install-time beacon runs against any installer regardless of affiliation and ships host identifiers to attacker-controlled collectors without consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
